IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Tuesday 10 November
Winds: Southeasterly 10 to 15 knots becoming variable below 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

Wednesday 11 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots tending southerly in the middle of the day then turning westerly 10 to 15 knots in the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 12 November
Winds: Northwesterly below 10 knots tending east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then tending south to southeasterly in the early afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 13 November
Winds: South to southwesterly below 10 knots tending southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the morning then tending southerly during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

Saturday 14 November
Winds: Southwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending southerly 15 to 20 knots during the morning then turning westerly below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A weakening cold front in the south west is expected to skim across the south on Tuesday night. This front is forecast to clear eastwards early Wednesday before a ridge of high pressure develops from the west. This ridge is expected to persist until Friday before it is eroded by a weak trough developing off the east coast. This trough is forecast to weaken on Saturday before a cold front approaches the west coast in the late evening.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Tuesday 10 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots, reaching up to 20 knots inshore in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Easterly 1 to 1.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Wednesday 11 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots turning westerly 20 to 25 knots during the morning. Winds reaching up to 30 knots during the afternoon and evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning, then increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres around midday.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Easterly around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Thursday 12 November
Winds: Westerly 15 to 25 knots becoming variable about 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: 1.5 to 2.5 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning, then decreasing below 1 metre around midday.
Swell: Southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 13 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming west to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots during the morning then tending southeast to southwesterly during the day.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2 metres inshore, increasing to 2 to 3 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy. 50% chance of showers.
